subject: ArbRadar · 24 September 2026 — Egypt defeats Saudi real estate investors’ mega-claim

stories.title: Egypt defeats Saudi real estate investors’ mega-claim
stories.summary: Egypt has defeated claims worth more than US$34 billion brought by Saudi real estate investors under the OIC investment agreement, after a divided tribunal said the state’s consent to arbitrate could not be imported from another treaty using a most-favoured nation clause.
stories.story: Egypt has defeated claims worth more than US$34 billion brought by Saudi real estate investors under the OIC investment agreement.

stories.title: US tech company gets fraud suit sent to arbitration
stories.summary: A US data cloud company has won its bid to compel arbitration of a US$100 million lawsuit lodged by a former employee over an alleged fraud involving a cryptocurrency venture.
stories.story: A US data cloud company has won its bid to compel arbitration of a US$100 million lawsuit lodged by a former employee over an alleged fraud involving a cryptocurrency venture.

stories.title: Three Crowns Taps Freshfields Pro For New Dubai Office
stories.title_en: Three Crowns Taps Freshfields pro for new Dubai office
stories.summary: Three Crowns LLP on Wednesday announced a significant partner hire for its new Dubai International Financial Centre office, saying Freshfields LLP's Saudi Arabia disputes practice head has departed that firm to contribute to the global arbitration specialist.
stories.story: Three Crowns LLP on Wednesday announced a partner hire for its new Dubai International Financial Centre office.

stories.title: Hong Kong court sets aside US$480 million award in IPO dispute
stories.summary: In a rare example of a successful set-aside in Hong Kong, a court has annulled an HKIAC award that ordered two shareholders in a listing vehicle to pay a co-investor US$480 million over a failed initial public offering, finding the tribunal did not properly address an estoppel defence.
